items.title: Populate AuditConfig.parallelGate in resolveAuditConfig: per-profile defaults + a resolveParallelGate(raw, profileDefault) helper validating the nested object field-by-field (mode/maxConcurrentReview/broadGlobBlocks) with guards and fallbacks per spec 4.7
items.context: core/audit-config.ts: add PARALLEL_GATE_PROFILE_DEFAULTS (light advise/2/false, balanced advise/3/false, strict block/4/true), import VALID_PARALLEL_MODES + ParallelGateConfig from parallel-decomposition.js, add resolveParallelGate with per-sub-field guard+fallback (invalid mode -> warn + advise; maxConcurrentReview integer >= 1 else profile default; broadGlobBlocks boolean else profile default; missing/non-object -> all profile defaults), set merged.parallelGate from the user override and profile default

happy.desc: resolveParallelGate({mode:"block",maxConcurrentReview:5,broadGlobBlocks:true}, lightDefault) -> returns {mode:"block",maxConcurrentReview:5,broadGlobBlocks:true}; WHY: proves valid overrides are applied field-by-field
resolveParallelGate(undefined, balancedDefault) -> returns balancedDefault {advise,3,false}; WHY: proves missing/undefined raw yields full profile defaults without crash

resolveAuditConfig("light", projectRoot) with NO user config file -> returned config.parallelGate equals {advise,2,false}; WHY: proves the no-user-config early-return path carries a populated parallelGate

resolveAuditConfig for each profile (light/balanced/strict) with no user overrides -> parallelGate matches PARALLEL_GATE_PROFILE_DEFAULTS: light={advise,2,false}, balanced={advise,3,false}, strict={block,4,true}; WHY: proves per-profile default table is wired correctly

resolveParallelGate({mode:"off"}, balancedDefault) -> returns {mode:"off",maxConcurrentReview:3,broadGlobBlocks:false}; WHY: proves mode off is accepted as a valid escape hatch (not rejected as invalid)

edge.desc: resolveParallelGate({mode:"nope"}, strictDefault) -> warns to console and returns {mode:"advise",...} (NOT block); WHY: proves invalid mode degrades to safe non-blocking advise fallback, not the profile default block
resolveParallelGate({maxConcurrentReview:0}, balancedDefault) -> warns and returns maxConcurrentReview=3 (profile default); WHY: boundary -- zero is not a valid positive integer
resolveParallelGate({maxConcurrentReview:-1}, balancedDefault) -> warns and returns profile default; WHY: negative integer boundary
resolveParallelGate({maxConcurrentReview:2.5}, strictDefault) -> warns and returns 4 (profile default); WHY: non-integer float boundary
resolveParallelGate({broadGlobBlocks:"yes"}, balancedDefault) -> returns broadGlobBlocks=false (profile default); WHY: string is not boolean, must fall back
resolveParallelGate with only mode set (no maxConcurrentReview/broadGlobBlocks keys) -> missing sub-fields inherit from profileDefault; WHY: proves partial override merges correctly

adversarial.desc: resolveParallelGate("not-an-object", lightDefault) -> returns full lightDefault with no throw; WHY: string input must not crash the resolver
resolveParallelGate([1,2,3], balancedDefault) -> returns full balancedDefault; WHY: array is typeof object but not a valid config; Array.isArray guard must catch it
resolveParallelGate(null, strictDefault) -> returns full strictDefault; WHY: null is typeof object, must be guarded

resolveParallelGate({mode:123,maxConcurrentReview:"abc",broadGlobBlocks:99}, balancedDefault) -> all three sub-fields fall back to profile defaults with warnings; WHY: every sub-field receives wrong type simultaneously
resolveParallelGate({maxConcurrentReview:Infinity}, lightDefault) -> falls back to profile default 2; WHY: Infinity is a number but not finite/integer, must be rejected

items.title: Hermetic smoke: per-profile defaults resolve correctly, each sub-field override is honored, and each malformed sub-field warns and falls back (config never crashes)
items.context: new task smoke under packages/main/src/tasks/; call resolveAuditConfig / resolveParallelGate with in-memory or temp-dir config inputs; assert the 3 profile default rows, a valid override is applied, an invalid mode falls back to advise, a non-integer maxConcurrentReview falls back, a non-boolean broadGlobBlocks falls back, and a non-object parallelGate yields all profile defaults; register in lattice.config.json

happy.desc: smoke registered in lattice.config.json validate.commands and runs via lattice validate without error; WHY: proves the smoke is discoverable and executes cleanly end-to-end

smoke asserts resolveAuditConfig for all 3 profiles with no user config -> parallelGate matches profile defaults (light advise/2/false, balanced advise/3/false, strict block/4/true); WHY: covers the primary per-profile default contract

smoke asserts a valid full override {mode:"block",maxConcurrentReview:5,broadGlobBlocks:true} is applied via resolveAuditConfig with temp audit-config.json; WHY: proves user overrides flow through the full config pipeline
smoke asserts mode:off is accepted and returned as-is; WHY: proves the reversible escape hatch works in the integrated path

edge.desc: smoke asserts invalid mode ("nope") warns to stderr/console and falls back to advise; WHY: proves the warn+fallback path in the integrated smoke, not just the unit helper
smoke asserts non-integer maxConcurrentReview (e.g. 2.5 or "abc") falls back to profile default; WHY: proves sub-field guard in integrated path
smoke asserts non-boolean broadGlobBlocks falls back to profile default; WHY: proves boolean guard in integrated path
smoke asserts non-object parallelGate (string or array) yields all profile defaults with no crash; WHY: proves top-level type guard in integrated path
smoke asserts no-user-config path still returns a populated parallelGate (not undefined); WHY: proves the early-return path is tested

adversarial.desc: smoke writes a temp audit-config.json with parallelGate set to null and verifies resolveAuditConfig returns profile defaults without throwing; WHY: null is a common real-world misconfiguration that must not crash

smoke writes audit-config.json where parallelGate has extra unknown keys alongside valid ones and verifies the valid keys are still applied (unknown keys ignored); WHY: forward-compatibility -- operators may add keys from a newer version
